messages.subject: onions
parts:
The attached .stan file implements yet another way to draw a correlation matrix from the LKJ distribution. It works well if you call it from R with

onion <- stan(file = "onion.stan", model_name = "onion", data = list(K = 4, eta = 1))

But if you move the model block to the end of the file and rename the generated quantities block to transformed parameters, then it fails to initialize after 100 attempts and aborts with the "No acceptably small step size could be found. Perhaps the posterior is not continuous?" statement. This does not make sense because the implied correlation matrix created in transformed parameters is not even used and the primitive parameters are just standard normals and betas. So, I think something else is going on, but it is not spitting out any useful messages.

Ben
